text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Vietnamese and American war veterans have exchanged documents about people listed as missing in action from the Vietnam War.
-- The Agricuture and Rural Development Ministry has issued measures aimed at halting migration to the central highlands.
-- South Korea's Lucky Goldstar plans to invest some $52.5 million in infrastructure projects for the Dung Quat Industrial Park in Quang Ngai province.
-- The government says efficent state enterprises will be allowed to borrow money from state banks without collateral.

-- Communist Party Secretary General Do Muoi has told U.S ambassador Pete Peterson that Vietnam will continue its efforts to help resolve the missing-in-action issue and hopes there will be similar assistance from the U.S side.
-- Vietnam and China signed a protocol on implementation of a road transportation agreement.
-- Vietnam has outlined campaign instructions for candidates involved in the upcoming National Assembly election on July 20.
-- Seven people were arrested last week for their alleged involvement in the embezzlement of more than $300,000 from a hotel project in Hanoi.
